# @arki/react-hooks

> Curated React hooks under one package: debounce, local storage, media query, hotkeys, clipboard, toggle, pagination, touch and viewport. One subpath per hook, no root import.

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/react-hooks/async-memo`: `useAsyncMemo`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/copy-to-clipboard`: `useCopyToClipboard`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/debounce`: `useDebouncedCallback`, `useDebouncedState`, `useDebouncedValue`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/hotkeys`: `useHotkeys`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/is-client`: Hook to detect if we're on the client side after hydration. `useIsClient`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/local-storage`: `deleteFromStorage`, `useLocalStorage`, `writeStorage`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/long-press`: `useLongPress`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/media-query`: `useIsDesktop`, `useIsMobile`, `useIsTablet`, `useIsTabletOrDesktop`, `useIsTouchDevice`, `useMediaQuery`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/pagination`: `usePagination`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/timeout`: `useTimeout`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/toggle`: `useToggle`, `useToggleState`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/touch`: `useIsTouchDevice`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/use-swipe-gesture`: `useNumberSwipeGesture`, `useSwipeGesture`; types `SwipeDirection`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/use-touch-feedback`: `useTouchFeedback`; types `HapticFeedbackType`.
- `@arki/react-hooks/use-viewport`: `useViewport`; types `ViewportInfo`, `ViewportType`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- There is no root import. Use a subpath such as `@arki/react-hooks/debounce`.
- `useAsyncMemo` does not catch a rejected promise. Catch inside the factory.
- `useViewport` calls under 640px mobile, `useIsMobile` calls under 768px mobile.
- On the server the `useIs*` hooks return `false`; the client value arrives after the first effect.
